pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and jagged pixel gradients; larger spatial area on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with distinct tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette extending along the superior neck line, representing a continuous mane structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two small avian figures (oxpeckers) perched on the subject: one at the cervico-thoracic junction of the dorsal ridge and another on the lower posterior flank.
